title: Maniac Magic
description: you can cast spells from various anime.
body:
I've recreated famous anime magic spells!

How to use:

Get the staff:
Run the command: /function frieren:give_staff

Select a spell:
Hold the staff in your main hand. Use [Right-click] or [Sneak + Right-click] to cycle through the spells.

Cast the spell:
Once selected, move the staff to your off-hand and [Right-click] to fire.

List of 13 Spells:　△ = Sneak + Right-click / □ = Right Click

0... [...] (Fly)

1... [△...] (Shield)

2... [△□...] (Wall)

3... [△△...] (Waterball)

4... [△□□...] (heathand)

5... [△□△...] (Icicle Break)

6... [△△□...] (Fireball)

7... [△△△...] (Zoltraak) ★

8... [△□□□...] (Sonar) ★★

9... [△□□△...] (Explode Mine)

10... [△□△□...] (Dragon Lightning) ★

11... [△□△△...] (Chain Dragon Lightning)

12... [△△□□...] (Explosion) ★


Your max mana cap raises based on your XP level.
Drink a Potion of Healing (Instant Health) to replenish your mana.
